opportunities.name: Boulder bruiser delivery
opportunities.objective: Use three boulder attacks and a terrain pin to test health-to-AD investment.
opportunities.mechanic: Q empowers three attacks with attack speed and physical scalings; the final attack has 11% target-max-health damage. Bloodmail converts bonus health to AD and Titanic rewards attacks. E wall collision has AD[statFormula=2] and health physical scaling; W shield uses Stat(12). Passive magic damage remains separate from Cleaver armor reduction.
opportunities.requiredState: Complete the three attacks and E wall collision with finite health and observed AD.
opportunities.failure: Kiting forces early Q throw and removes attack-dependent item value.
opportunities.test: Compare three-attack Q versus immediate throw, logging physical packets, passive magic and W shield.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Q Stat(12)[statFormula=2] is retained; do not silently substitute total health.

opportunities.name: Suppression escort field
opportunities.objective: Explore AP plus nearby amplification around a multi-target R drag.
opportunities.mechanic: R has 1 AP magic damage and can suppress three champions while granting move speed on a hit. W has 0.8 AP area magic damage plus a self shield. Cosmic can help reposition after magic contact and Abyssal amplifies nearby magic while Liandry tests follow-up damage; E supplies the initial pin.
opportunities.requiredState: R hits at least one champion and the drag keeps targets near allied magic damage.
opportunities.failure: The AP slots lower defenses, and a miss leaves no protected escort interval.
opportunities.test: Record R victims, drag distance, aura proximity and W/passive damage separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R triggering an active Q throw does not prove each target gets three passive stacks.

ruledOut.reason: Passive lists attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval and Impale; W is not listed as a Quaking applicator.

unknowns: Q throw references helpers; health statFormula=2 needs resolution. Drag animation and move-speed effects require live checks.

Bloodmail converts bonus health to AD and Titanic rewards attacks. E wall collision has AD[statFormula=2] and health physical scaling; W shield uses Stat(12). testPlan: Required state: Complete the three attacks and E wall collision with finite health and observed AD.
Compare three-attack Q versus immediate throw, logging physical packets, passive magic and W shield.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Kiting forces early Q throw and removes attack-dependent item value.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Q Stat(12)[statFormula=2] is retained; do not silently substitute total health.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Titanic Hydra, Black Cleaver, Sterak's Gage, Spirit Visage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Skarner gains [(0.08) × Stat(12)] Shield for [2.5]s and triggers an earthquake that deals [50 / 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage and Slows nearby enemies by [20]% for [1]s.

Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge.

Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals [30 / 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.06) × Stat(12)] physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for [1.1]s.

Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early.

Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with [(0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × 100]% Attack Speed and dealing [10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.03) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional [11]% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by [40]% for [1]s.

Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing @spell.SkarnerQ:AbilityDamage@ + @spell.SkarnerQ:MaxHPPercent*100@% max Health physical damage, and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by @spell.SkarnerQ:SlowPercent*100@% for @spell.SkarnerQ:SlowDuration@s.

Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking for [4]s. At [3] stacks of Quaking, enemies take [(characterLevelInterpolation(5 → 9; raw flags preserved)) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage over its duration.
